# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/gen_reference.py; do not edit. -->

GIAP: genome-integrated analysis of proteomics data for bacterial genomes.

## giap compare

Compare runs on the same genome (CMP/tables/compare_*.tsv, V16, report/compare.html).

| Option | Type | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RUNS` | `DIRECTORY` | required | — | — |
| `--outdir` | `PATH` | required | — | Comparison output directory. |
| `--labels` | `TEXT` | — | — | Comma-separated run labels. |
| `--version` | flag | — | — | Show the version and exit. |
| `--config` | `FILE` | — | — | YAML config file. |
| `--set` | `KEY=VALUE` | — | — | Override any config key (dotted, repeatable; VALUE is YAML). |
| `--log-level` | `CHOICE` | `INFO` | `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR` | Logging verbosity. |

## giap makedb

Build an optional strain search database (no FDR is built on it).

| Option | Type | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--annotation` | `FILE` | — | — | bakta.json. |
| `--genome` | `FILE` | — | — | Genome FASTA (default: the JSON sequences). |
| `--outdir` | `PATH` | required | — | Output database directory. |
| `--db-dir` | `PATH` | — | — | Database directory (default: $GIAP_DB_DIR). |
| `--six-frame-orfs` | flag | — | — | Add six-frame ORFs. |
| `--min-orf-aa` | `INTEGER` | `20` | — | — |
| `--patch` | `FILE` | — | — | annotation_patch.gff3 from a previous run. |
| `--no-contaminants` | flag | — | — | Do not append contaminant proteins. |
| `--version` | flag | — | — | Show the version and exit. |
| `--config` | `FILE` | — | — | YAML config file. |
| `--set` | `KEY=VALUE` | — | — | Override any config key (dotted, repeatable; VALUE is YAML). |
| `--log-level` | `CHOICE` | `INFO` | `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR` | Logging verbosity. |

## giap setup

Download databases and models (writes DIR/db_manifest.json).

| Option | Type | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--db-dir` | `PATH` | required | — | Database directory. |
| `--bakta` | `CHOICE` | `light` | `light`, `full`, `skip` | — |
| `--genomad` / `--no-genomad` | flag | `true` | — | — |
| `--antismash` / `--no-antismash` | flag | `false` | — | — |
| `--promotech-models` / `--no-promotech-models` | flag | `true` | — | — |
| `--go` | flag | — | — | Gene Ontology and GO slims. |
| `--kegg` | flag | — | — | KEGG resources. |
| `--cog` | flag | — | — | COG categories. |
| `--contaminants` | flag | — | — | Contaminant protein sequences. |
| `--check` | flag | — | — | Only verify what is installed. |
| `--images` | `[all]` | — | — | Pull the pinned container images the config needs (with 'all': every pinned image). |
| `--profile` | `apptainer|docker` | — | — | Container runtime for --images (a comma-joined Nextflow profile is accepted). |
| `--cache-dir` | `PATH` | — | — | Apptainer image cache [default: NXF_APPTAINER_CACHEDIR, $GIAP_ROOT/containers, DIR/containers]. |
| `--version` | flag | — | — | Show the version and exit. |
| `--config` | `FILE` | — | — | YAML config file. |
| `--set` | `KEY=VALUE` | — | — | Override any config key (dotted, repeatable; VALUE is YAML). |
| `--log-level` | `CHOICE` | `INFO` | `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, `ERROR` | Logging verbosity. |
